description: Frozen paraphrase-retrieval gate: 200 authored (fact, paraphrase-query, distractor-query) triples across ops, dev, personal-preference and scheduling. hit@3 = fact retrieved in the top 3 for its paraphrase. distractor@1 = fact ranked first for its distractor (lower is better).
